emails.subject: SOC advisory: active phishing campaign impersonating Microsoft and DocuSign
emails.body_plain:
Internal SOC advisory.

We're tracking an uptick in phishing emails impersonating Microsoft 365 admin notifications and DocuSign expiry notices, targeting our IT team specifically.

Known sender domains: micros0ft-support.net, d0cusign-secure.com, microsoft365-admin-help.app, and others.

If any of your team forwarded these to us already — thanks. Please reply if you have additional samples; we're updating the email security gateway rules tonight.

— Aurora SOC

emails.subject: Re: VPN auth — early triage notes
emails.body_plain:
Cobbi,

Quick triage notes from my side on the VPN issue:

1. Looks like it correlates with the certificate rotation we did Saturday night.
2. The cert chain is missing the intermediate that the older clients still need.
3. I think we can fix it by re-pushing the chain via Jamf.

Want to jump on a call to confirm the rollout plan, or do you want to handle it solo? I have bandwidth.

— Hiroshi
